hypothesis: Adding one narrow multilingual idiom and cultural-expression verification instruction can reduce llm_judge failures without changing decoding or scorer behavior.

evidence_used.observation: Korean and Turkish idiom failures remain visible in local diagnostic samples.
Broad semantic-v1 routing improved llm_judge but damaged refusal balance; semantic-v2 narrowed scope but canary did not confirm promotion.
p3-dev-v2 remains the conservative local default because dev and canary both improved SHIFT versus split baseline.

change_spec.allowed_scope: one prompt-profile instruction line for multilingual idiom/cultural-expression rows

risk_assessment.overfit_risk: medium: proposal is derived from public local diagnostic failure samples
risk_assessment.leakage_risk: low: no hidden labels or official results are used
risk_assessment.regression_risk: medium: semantic-v1 showed refusal balance regression, so scope must remain narrow

next_if_success: keep as local candidate and require canary confirmation before replacing p3-dev-v2
next_if_failure: rollback prompt line and preserve failure evidence
claim_boundary: local diagnostic proposal only; not official and not a leaderboard score claim
